paragraphs: PeerConnect is described on its own site as support management software to automate, integrate and help manage a support program. The site says the software makes it easy for members to request and receive peer support. It can integrate to a CAD system so that members are checked in on after a traumatic call, with live measurements, de-identified statistics and reporting.

Listed features include proactive interval check-ins and ad hoc recommendations when incidents occur. Self-assessments give front line staff a baseline understanding of how they are feeling. A service directory and library of wellness content covers community and EAP offerings. Reporting generates a snapshot of a wellness program's metrics as PDFs.

The company says PeerConnect was founded with a mission to support first responders in their mental health and well-being. The platform is described as helping departments and organizations provide the care and connection their teams need. Prospective customers are invited to book a demo of a web-based solution that complements an existing peer support program.

quote.text: PeerConnect makes it easy for members to request and receive peer support, ensuring no member walks alone.
